args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money

The docstring and tests expect banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
per FIN-212, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
nightly test failures in tests/test_money.py.

files.content:
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Fixed `round_money` to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212; previously
  rounded half away from zero (`ROUND_HALF_UP`), breaking `tests/test_money.py`.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
- `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure.
- This PR changes `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching its existing docstring and FIN-212.
- Also adds a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `6004fe303a` passed (including `tests/test_money.py`).

Please review and approve so this can ship in today's release.
